scope: Fresh-install source and extracted signed-package native fixtures; no foreign-suite package selection or source build.

contract.module_and_allowlist: Unchanged two fixed quoted literal config selector operands; no extra arguments or arbitrary paths.
contract.themes: Ordinary per-profile native directories; packaged and builtin theme lookup preserved. No directory-symlink exception in the trusted account-template reader.
contract.skeleton: Existing validated staging gateways, exact regular config target, idempotent link creation, conflict refusal.
contract.primary_account: Explicit installer-only operation after independent publication. Validate account/home; close root-only source descriptor, permanently clear groups and drop GID/UID, then create exact views through the pinned HOME descriptor. No restoration of root.
contract.future_accounts: Actual existing trusted snapshot preserves both links to regular authored configs and resolves copied bytes; ordinary native themes directories. Original finite operation deadline and generic link policy preserved.
contract.firstboot: Only validates installed view paths; no view creation, template rendering or class-receipt parsing.

native.cases: Actual wrapper argv -> Foot/PTY -> both real btop binaries; selected config opens traced; titles and HUP status observed.

Actual source CLI publication/permanent-UID-drop operation; account-owned exact views, idempotent inode, retained conflict, symlink-parent/hardlink rejection and retry convergence. Future-account link normalization checked separately.

Current skeleton writer and actual primary source CLI operation; exact links, idempotence, hostile metadata, retained conflict, retry; actual future-account snapshot/target validation. System-call trace proves source descriptor closure before permanent group/GID/UID drop.
